title: The harness must not fail a task on its own worktree's leftovers
goal: A funded mission ran the worker, the worker edited tests/gmcp_requirements.rs but did not commit within its turns, and the next attempt died at prepare with 'workflow sync failed: Commit or stash your work before syncing'. The worktree is the harness's own, a failed attempt leaves edits that the next attempt would discard anyway, so sync must discard them (git reset --hard + clean -fd) and retry once instead of failing the whole task. A non-leftover failure must still surface unchanged.
